conflict_resolutions.PARTIAL_END_CANDIDATE_ON_YES_ORDER: The machine lead 'rescission 2017-01-03' points to the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission's final rule of January 3, 2017 (82 FR 654, FR Doc. 2016-31397, held at jobs/selden-fr-citers/output/texts/fr-2016-31397.txt). That document is an Equal Employment Opportunity Commission rule on 29 CFR Part 1614 that cites Executive Order 12067 as authority for the Commission to issue rules; it does not revoke, rescind or amend Executive Order 12067 or any section of it. Its only uses of 'rescind' or 'rescissions' concern the statute's grant of power to rescind procedural regulations and rescissions of conditional job offers. The one disposition note for the order in the OFR catalog is the amendment by Executive Order 12107.

research_rationale:
Identity: the held Federal Register text (43 FR 28967, July 5, 1978; jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12067.txt) is Executive Order 12067 of June 30, 1978, Providing for Coordination of Federal Equal Employment Opportunity Programs, issued under Section 9 of Reorganization Plan Number 1 of 1978 (43 FR 19807). Inventory: Sections 1-101, 1-201 to 1-203, 1-301 (with paragraphs (a) to (i)), 1-302 to 1-306, 1-307 (a) to (c), 1-401, 1-501 and 1-502, as in the dossier; the section headings are not clauses. Later instruments: Executive Order 12107 (signed December 28, 1978; effective January 1, 1979 under its section 2-404) lists this order in section 2-101(b) and so substitutes the Office of Personnel Management for the Civil Service Commission; the only clause in which the Civil Service Commission appears is Section 1-302. Executive Order 13583 (August 18, 2011) section 4(a)(i) recites that nothing in it impairs the authority granted to the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission by Executive Order 12067; it neither amends nor ends this order. The dossier's chain is empty and its 'target provision not located' lines for Executive Orders 12107 and 13583 are explained by these two readings. The one dossier conflict, a machine lead of a 'rescission 2017-01-03', is resolved in conflict_resolutions. Current law: the held original and the three bounded searches were read with their coverage notes (U.S. Code through 2026-10-09; eCFR as of 2026-10-14; OFR catalog checked 2026-11-25) and support operative status on 2026-10-14. The held text of the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission's final rule of January 3, 2017 (82 FR 654) invokes the order as continuing authority to issue rules, and a later Commission rule (85 FR 35558, FR Doc. 2020-10965) is held among the packet's actor contexts.

savings.reason: Section 1-101 fixes July 1, 1978 as the date on which the functions of the Equal Employment Opportunity Coordinating Council transferred to the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission and the Council terminated, under Section 6 of Reorganization Plan Number 1 of 1978. The clause is recorded as performed on that date; the transferred functions remain with the Commission and are exercised through the continuing clauses of this order.
